evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Creation of games is present and complementary capabilities (invite, browse, delete) exist in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Invitation creation is paired with a join action (PP-029), so the capability is complete.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Starting rounds and entering items is supported and there are item add/edit/delete stories, so no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate
evaluations.rationale: Item listing is supported alongside add/edit/delete item stories; no missing complements evident.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting items to estimate is supported together with item-management stories; no complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Item creation exists and is paired with edit/delete and selection, so this does not expose a completeness gap.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Edit is complemented by add (PP-006) and delete (PP-008) so no creation/update completeness gap.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Delete is paired with add/edit stories (PP-006, PP-007); no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: The backlog assumes estimates exist to be shown, but there is no story that allows estimators to submit/give an estimate (e.g., "As an estimator I want to submit my estimate").

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting an average requires that individual estimates are submitted; there is no story enabling estimators to submit their estimates.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Auto-filling depends on estimators showing/selecting cards (submitting estimates), but no story provides the capability for estimators to play/submit an estimate.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Moderator-entered agreed estimate is a standalone capability; it does not strictly require a missing complementary story to exist in order to be implemented.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimating is covered by existing round/item management stories (e.g., PP-003, PP-005); it does not uniquely expose a missing complementary action.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Import and copy/paste capabilities are both present (PP-015), so no complementary capability is missing for importing stories.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste and import stories complement each other; no missing capability evident.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is supported and complemented by transcript/export and delete features; storage of games is implied elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Transcripts and exports (PP-018, PP-019) indicate storage and retrieval of game data; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting transcripts is supported and paired with viewing (PP-017); storage of transcripts is present in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export complements transcript viewing and previous-games browsing; no necessary complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Game deletion complements creation (PP-001) and browsing; necessary complements are present.

evaluations.evidence: create an account
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is present and paired with login/manage/delete; no missing complementary account capability.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is complemented by account creation (PP-021) and account management; no necessary complement missing.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account editing is paired with account creation and deletion; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion complements account creation (PP-021); required complementary capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display can be implemented using client or stored preference; no required complementary story is missing.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder is a standalone capability; no complementary requirement is missing from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, ...}
evaluations.rationale: Choice of card set is self-contained; no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Invitation limit complements invitation creation (PP-002) and join (PP-029); no required capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL
evaluations.rationale: Join complements invitation (PP-002); necessary complementary capability exists.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Displaying the current item is supported by round/item selection stories; no complementary requirement missing.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Session item listing is covered by item management and round stories; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given
evaluations.rationale: This story presumes that estimators can submit/give estimates, but there is no story enabling estimators to actually submit their estimate (no 'as an estimator, I want to submit an estimate').

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Showing estimates after all have given requires an estimator submission capability which is absent from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card
evaluations.rationale: Changing an estimate presumes the ability to submit/select a card; no story provides the action for estimators to submit/select their estimate.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates presumes those estimates were recorded via estimator submissions; backlog lacks a story for submitting estimates.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: This requires that estimators can submit/record their estimates; no submission capability is specified in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer start is self-contained and accompanied by a reset story (PP-038); the capability itself is implementable without missing complements.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Resetting the timer based on 'all play an estimate' depends on estimator submission actions; there is no story that enables estimators to play/submit an estimate.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Accessing prior rounds' estimates assumes those estimates were created/submitted and persist; while transcripts exist, the backlog lacks an estimator-submission story to produce those estimates.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering is a UI/display requirement and does not require a missing complementary capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Changing an estimate presumes estimators can submit/select estimates; the backlog contains no story that enables estimators to submit their estimate.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying a thumbnail presumes users have a photo/avatar to display, but there is no story to upload/set a thumbnail or avatar for a user account.

evaluations.evidence: site compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: This developer non-functional requirement is self-contained and does not expose a complementary capability gap.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Providing definitions is standalone documentation work and does not reveal missing functional complements.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Database indexing is an implementation task that doesn't indicate a missing complementary user-level capability.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Cross-browser support is a quality requirement; it does not expose a missing complementary feature in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is a non-functional/developer requirement and does not reveal missing complementary user stories.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance requirement is self-contained; no necessary complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a platform/implementation requirement and does not reveal a missing complementary user story.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design is an implementation/detail requirement and not missing a complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error-page design is a UX requirement and does not reveal a missing complementary functional story.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Data anonymization/storage is specified and complements transcript/export stories; no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics can be derived from stored game/transcript data (PP-017 etc.); backlog provides storage/export capabilities, so no complementary capability is clearly missing.
